name: The Meadow
_comment: The world the demo runs in. Every number here is read twice: once by src/andropia/worlds/build.py and describe.py, which turn it into landmarks and into the paragraph beings are given, and once by frontend/src/world.js, which draws it. That is the whole reason this file exists — a description and a scene that are two sources of truth will disagree, and the disagreement surfaces as beings discussing the water level of a pond that is a point on a flat plane.
atmosphere: Late afternoon, warm and still, some hours after rain.

ground.description: damp grass, long enough to move underfoot, soft where it has held the rain

sky.description: a wide pale sky going gold at the edges

features.description: a broad shallow pond, still enough to hold the sky, cold at the ankle
a dense stand of reeds at the pond's far edge, over head height
a flat mossy rock, wide enough to sit on and warm on top
a lone fence post, grey with weather, with nothing fenced to either side
a long low rise in the ground, gentle enough to walk straight up

license.notice: Numbers written for this project. A parametric world pack has no third-party asset in it, which is what makes it safe to ship with the source.
